recommendation_summary: Set up a single hosted heartbeat check (e.g. Healthchecks.io) that `nightly-sync` pings only after it succeeds, with a daily deadline plus grace period and email alerts when the ping is missing.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` stops working, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving the job into Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The script must finish before it can send its existing email.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts; I haven’t inspected the machines or verified a service.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, sets aside central logging and Docker, and puts all four record lines before the recommendation.
